Population increased in Wokingham

The estimated population of Wokingham in 2024 was 187,200 usual residents, a rise of 1.4% since 2023.

This meant that Wokingham's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Wokingham increased by 5%.

Over this slightly longer period, Wokingham was also among the 20% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Wokingham

The average (median) age rose to 41.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Wokingham has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Wokingham is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Wokingham's population of 187,200 usual residents was made up of:

  • 39,348 people aged 0 to 15 years, (21%)
  • 115,333 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.6%)
  • 32,519 people aged 65 years and over, (17.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Wokingham has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (21% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Wokingham, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Wokingham
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Wokingham, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 478 people (0.3%). In total, there were 1,726 births and 1,248 deaths in Wokingham.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 446 (0.2%). There were 12,919 people entering the area and 12,473 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Wokingham's population of 1,729 (0.9%) as a result of 2,900 people entering the area and 1,171 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Wokingham was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Wokingham in mid-2023 is 184,561.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 534 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 157 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 691 people.
